description: This file 'IoHwAb_Dcm.h' contains the configuration for the IoHwAb module related to DCM (Diagnostic Communication Manager) for the MPC5567 microcontroller. It includes version checks, includes a types header, and declares a function prototype for controlling a digital signal (LED).

methods.name: IoHwAb_Dcm_DigitalSignal_Red_Led
methods.description: Function to control the Red LED digital signal, with parameters for action and value.
